reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 35. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
I’m grateful to our law enforcement and emergency personnel for their swift, thorough response to the bomb threat in downtown Peoria. 

Thankfully, no one was injured, and those who were in the evacuation area can now return to their homes safely. 

I will continue to work with

My office is monitoring the reported bomb threat at BioUrja Renewables in Peoria. Please follow instructions from the Peoria Police Department, evacuate if you are within the designated one-mile radius, and avoid the area until authorities say it is safe.

I’m grateful to the officers and emergency personnel for their quick response. I am praying for our Peoria community.

Jensen Huang’s actions weren’t only immoral, but a threat to our national security.

The risk of advanced chips falling into China’s hands and the regulations surrounding export controls must be revisited and addressed to protect America’s security and prevent sensitive technology from strengthening the CCP.
https://t.co/Akm7Dphzrz

Veterans who are injured in combat should never have to choose between the retirement benefits they earned and the disability compensation they deserve. 

That’s why I was proud to cosponsor the bipartisan Major Richard Star Act and vote for it today on the House floor.

Today, we honor the brave men and women who risked their lives for our nation and the values it represents.

It is because of their sacrifice, courage, and selfless service that we are able to live in the greatest country in the world. Thank you to all who answered the call to serve! 🇺🇸

Congratulations to my friend and colleague Jim Jordan on becoming the next @HouseGOP Leader! Time and again, he has proven himself to be a fighter who works tirelessly for the people of Ohio’s 4th District and Americans across the country.

I was proud to cast my vote for @Jim_Jordan because I know he will bring that same work ethic and conviction to this role to advance our shared priorities and secure conservative victories. 

I look forward to working alongside him to deliver real results for the American people! 🇺🇸

For 251 years, the @USMC has stood ready to defend our nation and our freedoms as the world’s premier fighting force.

We are forever grateful for the courage, sacrifice, and dedication of the men and women who have answered the call to serve in the Marine Corps. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/5lypb11z98

Congratulations to Peoria Notre Dame boys soccer on winning their sixth state championship in program history!

This was an incredible way to finish a record-setting season for Coach Bare, the staff, and all the players! Go Irish!!🍀
https://t.co/URhCpw5l4F

I am heartbroken by the shooting near Illinois Wesleyan University’s campus last night. Kristen and I are praying for the victims, their loved ones, and their families during this unimaginably difficult time.

I’m grateful to the first responders and law enforcement officers who responded quickly to help those in need and secure the area.
https://t.co/vnRfg0LOkx

I was grateful to join Channahon Mayor Missey Moorman Schumacher to celebrate the groundbreaking of The Talia, a project made possible by my Affordable Housing Tax Credit Improvement Act.

I’m committed to expanding affordable housing across Illinois so seniors, working families, https://t.co/1Pp7Fnm1WE

It was great to tour the new Petrick Idea Center at Illinois Wesleyan University with @SBA_Kelly and meet with students building the next generation of businesses.

Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts Act, we're helping small businesses and entrepreneurs invest, grow, and create opportunities in communities across Illinois.

American Energy Dominance means:

✅Lower costs
✅More jobs
✅Reliable power

Grateful to have @SecretaryWright and EDF Director Greg Beard in Byron yesterday to announce a $5 billion investment in our nation’s nuclear fleet, including major projects coming right here to #IL16. https://t.co/y7JFVBzT9y

Started off my day at the 18th annual Community Prayer Breakfast, hosted by the Germantown Hills Chamber of Commerce and Metamora Area Business Association.

It was great to hear Carl Cannon of Elite Community Outreach deliver a powerful address as the keynote speaker. 

Many thanks to the local leaders from schools, nonprofits, faith communities, government, and small businesses who joined this morning and for their collaboration on projects that continue to enhance the quality of life for central Illinois families.

Honored to welcome @SecretaryWright to Byron for this major announcement. 

This critical investment in Illinois will lower costs for hardworking families, support jobs, and help unleash American energy dominance! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/laSnA7Ixt6

I was honored to participate in yesterday’s groundbreaking ceremony for Eureka Apostolic Christian Home’s new facility, Walnut Crossing. 

As they celebrate 60 years of serving seniors, their faith-centered mission and record of outstanding care continue to make a meaningful difference in the lives of residents and their families. 

Congratulations to Administrator Kim Joos, Mayor Eric Lind, Board President Brad Walder, the board of directors, and everyone who helped make this possible!

M4 Steel in Washington is a great example of the American Dream in action!

Thanks to Frank Mendoza for hosting me and sharing what he’s seeing on the ground, including how @HouseGOP’s pro-growth tax policies are helping them invest in their workers, expand, and create more opportunities.

Congratulations to Rockford and Winnebago County on becoming the first community in Illinois to be named an American World War II Heritage City!

From Camp Grant and local manufacturing to the service and sacrifice of families from the region, the Greater Rockford Area played a

I was honored to join hundreds of volunteers in our Peoria community for Goodwill’s 18th Annual Stand Down for Homeless Veterans this morning.

This incredible event served more than 250 veterans by providing them with winter essentials and helping connect them with the care and services they need, including haircuts and health screenings.

A special thanks to the entire Goodwill staff, every volunteer and the veteran assistance organizations that came together to support those who served our country. 🇺🇸

I stopped by Peoria Christian High School and spoke with a bright group of students about how legislation becomes law, the importance of providing good constituent service and the role my faith plays in my day-to-day life. 

Many thanks to Superintendent Lyons, Principal Garrett, and all the staff for the outstanding work they do to support the next generation!

I’m deeply disturbed by the attempted attack at the Hindu temple in Aurora. A place of worship should be a sacred and safe place where families can gather and practice their faith without fear. 

This kind of hate and violence has no place in our country. I’m grateful Congressman Krishnamoorthi, his family, and everyone at the temple are safe. The criminal who attempted to carry out this heinous and despicable crime must be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law.
https://t.co/RSv4qtnIbQ

Many thanks to Dan and Tammy Roach and their team for hosting me at Cornerstone Retreat Center in Orion. 

I appreciated the chance to learn more about their mission to support first responders’ mental health and well-being. I’ll always support policies to ensure those who serve our communities have access to the resources and care they need.

Hezbollah is a malign cancer that will use any tool at its disposal to undermine Lebanon’s sovereignty.

The complaint against Ambassador Nada Hamadeh Moawad is a disgraceful attempt to obstruct diplomacy between Israel and Lebanon. Her excellent work is critical to building a safer and more prosperous Lebanon free from terrorist influence.
https://t.co/94xAE4wfDj

For 251 years, the @USNavy has defended our nation and upheld the ideals it represents across the seas.

Forever grateful to our brave sailors who answered the call to serve. Happy birthday to the world’s finest Navy! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/8F7DQIh6Ng

The Flanagan Library became a reality thanks to Kim Wargo’s tireless efforts and dedication.

I was grateful for the opportunity to visit the library to learn more about their educational services for kids, resources for families, and to discuss how I can support the incredible work they do!

One of my greatest privileges in this role is nominating exceptional young men and women from #IL16 to our nation’s service academies.

Thanks to Colonel Ballard and the @the182AW for hosting my Military Service Academy Night in Peoria yesterday to provide students considering a future of service with more information about the process!  🇺🇸

It was impressive to see the ingenuity and innovation happening at Morton Industries and their new East Peoria facility!

I’ll continue to support pro-growth policies, like the Working Families Tax Cuts Act, that help manufacturers like Morton Industries expand, create more good-paying jobs, and invest in our region.

Incredible turnout at today’s Walk to End Alzheimer’s in Peoria!

I’ll always stand shoulder to shoulder with the families and individuals impacted by Alzheimer’s while I continue my work in Congress to invest in research, improve early detection, and support patients as we work towards a cure.

Many thanks to all the volunteers and participants who made this year’s Walk a tremendous success!

It was great to tour Rock Valley College’s new downtown campus with President Howard Spearman and get a firsthand look at their programs that prepare students for careers in the trades and strengthen our local economy.

I’ve been proud to go to bat for a $480,000 federal investment to support the college’s law enforcement training program, and look forward to getting this funding across the finish line to improve public safety across Northern Illinois.

Harvest is underway across #IL16!

It was great to stop the Lay’s farm in Bloomington to see how harvest was coming along and discuss the importance of renewing the USMCA and the need for the Senate to pass the Farm Bill I was proud to support in the House.

As our farmers are in the fields this fall, remember to slow down and look out for farm equipment on the road! 🚜

American energy dominance means putting American workers, families, and our national security first.

By unleashing the full potential of American energy, we can end our reliance on foreign adversaries, lower costs, and create more good-paying jobs here at home.
https://t.co/RuVN52T6CG

As I’ve traveled across #IL16, I’ve heard from constituents like Ken about how the Working Families Tax Cuts Act is putting more money back in their pockets.

Thanks to @HouseGOP’s bill, our seniors are rightfully keeping more of what they’ve earned for a lifetime of hard work. https://t.co/p7k1fOSuVw

Today, we honor the mothers and families who have endured the unimaginable loss of a loved one in service to our nation.

May we always remember those who made the ultimate sacrifice in defense of our freedoms and honor the Gold Star families who carry on their legacy. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/QDbdIfQm3A

Thank you to Bloomington Mayor Dan Brady and our local officials for joining me to discuss our ongoing efforts to secure federal disaster relief following the severe storms that hit Bloomington-Normal and rural McLean County last month.

I’ll continue working with President Trump, his Administration, and FEMA to stress the need for this relief and ensure our communities have the resources they need to recover.
https://t.co/udE3KbEbau

Ahead of today’s beatification of Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen, I join communities across Central Illinois in the excitement surrounding this historic moment.

Archbishop Sheen’s deep ties to the Peoria Diocese and his remarkable legacy of faith and service continue to inspire people across our region and around the world.

Today is a proud and special day for Central Illinois.
https://t.co/F6tJ76HHLu

It was great to join Mayor John Kahl and Chief Dave Catton for a tour of the new East Peoria Police Department to learn more about how this new facility will help officers better serve and protect the people of East Peoria.

I’ll always stand with the men and women of law enforcement and support policies that give our police the tools and resources they need to do their jobs.

Many thanks to Chief Catton and all of our officers for the incredible work they do every day to keep our community safe!

Severe weather can have a devastating impact on families, homes, and communities, which is why continued innovation and research in building materials matters.

It was great to visit State Farm’s TRAIL Research Center in Bloomington, where I saw firsthand the importance of supporting research that helps families better protect their property, reduce costly damages, and build more resilient communities.

On World Alzheimer’s Day, we recognize the millions of Americans living with Alzheimer’s and the families and caregivers who support them every day.

Early detection can make a real difference. That’s why I’m proud my bipartisan CHANGE Act recently passed out of @WaysandMeansGOP to strengthen cognitive screenings and help detect Alzheimer’s and other forms of dementia sooner.

It is critical that we continue to support Alzheimer’s research as we work to improve treatments and find a cure.

I appreciated the opportunity to sit down with Hopedale Village President, Ace Eilts, to talk about the village’s priorities, how my office can be a partner, and my work to support the region.

I’m grateful to Mayor Eilts for his commitment to Hopedale and the families who call it home!

Happy 79th Birthday to the @usairforce!

Today, we honor the generations of American Airmen who have answered the call to defend our skies, protect our freedoms, and keep our nation safe.

Proud to have the brave men and women of the @the182AW here in Peoria! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/3H4rpD4s1W

Electricity costs from data centers shouldn’t be pushed onto American families and small businesses.

That’s why I proudly voted for the Ratepayer Protection Act to ensure data centers cover the additional electricity costs they create, not our local communities. https://t.co/2kfCvvCfYM

Every 65 seconds, someone in America develops Alzheimer’s.

Early detection is critical to closing the diagnosis gap and ensuring patients, families, and caregivers have the resources and support they need.

I thank my @WaysandMeansGOP colleagues for advancing the bipartisan ASAP Act, which included my CHANGE Act as a provision, to expand access to early Alzheimer’s detection and treatment.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Ratepayer Protection Act (H R 9340)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill tells state utility regulators to consider making very large power users, such as data centers using 100 megawatts or more, pay the full extra cost of grid upgrades built to serve them. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
